items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: and his brother Louis, Louis Kepler was playing guitar.

ctx.x: What did he play with? The Olympia band. The Olympia band. That's, and his brother Louis, Louis Kepler was playing guitar. Who's the drummer? The drummer was Henry, not Henry Zina, or Henry Martin. Henry Martin was the drummer. All the people in the corner in the corner of the state, Henry Martin. Henry Martin. Henry Martin. Did they have a violin with the Olympia?
They had a violin band then. The Cutterfella played violin. I don't know his name.
